name: OpenVibe.Tools
notes: Wave 11: asynchronous jobs on the img, audio and docs satellites (POST/GET/DELETE /api/v1/jobs, SSE events). Job lifecycle events tools.job.created|started|succeeded|failed have payload contracts (v0.30.0); Tools publishes them to OpenVibe.Events next. Tools consumes media.object.upload and media.object.read (namespace tools) when TOOLS_JOB_RESULTS=media.
